proves.claim: A landed receipt through boardJobQueueCall for a sprint item writes a landed landing_batch event carrying the exactTree record and the sha256 commandsDigest of the job's sprint commands.

api.gate.exact-tree-record.records-lande.why: Without it show and the store check would read no exact-tree record for a landed sprint item.

proves.claim: With landing.exactTreeCheck on, a sprint land receipt with no or a red exactTree leaves its items unmerged and records a blocked batch; with it off the item lands.

api.gate.exact-tree-record.refuses-witho.why: Without it a sprint tree that was never proved green would move main with the check on.

proves.claim: A steady-only land receipt writes merged and main-moved only, with the same board calls whether landing.exactTreeCheck is on or off.

api.gate.exact-tree-record.steady-unchan.why: Without it the sprint branch could add board calls or batch events to every steady landing.
